## Docs impact
List the docs you updated (zone README, contract, feature manifest, `AGENTS.md`, ...). If there is nothing to document, write one line: `Docs-Impact: none (specific reason)`.

## Checklist
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Docs updated per the map in `AGENTS.md` (or waived above with a real reason)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` updated if a command, convention or structure changed
- [ ] Terms, headings and file names follow `docs/STYLE.md`
- [ ] Only the files my task lists changed
- [ ] New dependency logged in docs/DECISIONS.md
- [ ] No secrets, no stray debug code
- [ ] docs/features/<feature>.md updated (if a feature changed)
